fact: On 27 July 2026 the Ministry of Education activated the national 'Vie scolaire' portal, a unified digital system with a parent account linked to the pupil file and a space for school heads, with regional staff training 20-30 July 2026.
title: Ministère de l'Éducation : le portail "Vie scolaire" entre en service pour une gestion numérique centralisée
